jobs.title: Functional Consultant (M&A)
jobs.description:
About Us:
HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across  Order-to-Cash ,  Close &   Reconciliation,   Consolidation & Reporting ,  Accounts Payable ,  B2B Payments , and  Treasury . HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+  enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and  more . HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a  market leader  by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.

Job Summary :
Functional Support Consultant will be responsible for providing support to our high-end, robust and scalable SaaS products. He/She plays a significant role as an extension of our internal teams, the ultimate HighRadian ambassador who delivers continuous support from the advent of the conflict to the time it gets resolved. S/he should be keen to learn about our complex software products and have a people-first mentality. If you are ready to leverage your grit, creativity and bit of wit and humor to experience an awesome company culture - then you should be a HighRadian!

Responsibilities :

- Responsible for providing product support to users of the Highradius applications.

- Own customer reported issues and drive them to resolution meeting the SLAs

- Provide a delightful customer experience by partnering with internal and external stake holders

- Supports and contributes to the growth of best practices for delivery of HighRadius Support services

- Understand HighRadius application troubleshooting practices to ensure successful resolution of the issues.

- Have the will to learn and understand our products and their features to support and educate clients

- Follow the Quality and Process compliance to do the right thing for customers and the organization

- Dynamically prioritize tickets and multi-task when needed

- To be a team player who can work in rotational shifts.

- To empathize with client situations and provide quick resolutions or workarounds.

- Have a collaborative approach to clearly communicate issues and resolutions with the internal teams and customers.

Requirements  :

- 2 to 5 years of experience in Application Support preferably a SaaS application

- Familiarity with tools & practices of the trade such as case management, knowledge base, defect & escalation management.

- A technology-centric background

- Strong logical, analytical and problem solving skills

- Excellent communication skills

- Can work in a fast paced, ever changing, start-up environment

- Proficiency in running SQL queries is a plus

- Scripting knowledge is a plus.

jobs.title: Analyst – Strategic Alliances
jobs.description:
About Us:

HighRadius, a renowned provider of cloud-based Autonomous Software for the Office of the CFO, has transformed critical financial processes for over 800+ leading companies worldwide.Trusted by prestigious organizations like 3M, Unilever, Anheuser-Busch InBev, Sanofi, Kellogg Company, Danone, Hershey's, and many others, HighRadius optimizes order-to-cash, treasury, and record-to-report processes, earning us back-to-back recognition in Gartner's Magic Quadrant and a prestigious spot in Forbes Cloud 100 List for three consecutive years.

With a remarkable valuation of $3.1B and an impressive annual recurring revenue exceeding $100M, we experience a robust year-over-year growth of 24%. With a global presence spanning 8+ locations, we're in the pre-IPO stage, poised for rapid growth. We invite passionate and diverse individuals to join us on this exciting path to becoming a publicly traded company and shape our promising future.

Job role : Senior Analyst – Strategic Alliances

You will work closely with the HighRadius leadership team in driving Partnership and Alliances strategy. You will be responsible for

- Managing Partner relationship and driving sales funnel

- Conducting research and data analysis to plan and execute high level touchpoint campaigns with senior executives around the globe.

- Liaisoning with internal / external stakeholders to collate information, deliver insights and work with the sales leaders in driving engagement initiatives.

This role requires a professional with high sales acumen, strong research, data analysis, and reporting experience. The individual should be able to communicate and engage with senior business leaders, and manage relationships independently.

Desired Requirements

- Graduate / Post Graduate with 2-4 years of post qualification experience and exposure to research, data analysis, and stakeholder management

Focused on

- Research skills and ability to use research tools

- Business acumen and analytical skills

- Ability to effectively collaborate with internal and external stakeholders

- Communication skills, both written and verbal

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

- Exposure to Salesforce and office productivity tools is a plus

- Prior experience in consulting / founder’s office / B2B SAAS pre-sales / marketing roles is a plus

What You’ll Get

- Competitive salary

- Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)

- Equal employment opportunities

- Opportunity to build with a pre-IPO Global SaaS Centaur

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Advisor | AP
jobs.description:
About HighRadius

HighRadius is the pioneer of AI-driven Autonomous Finance Solutions for the Office of the CFO. We have empowered over 800 global industry leaders, including 3M, Unilever, Sanofi, and Hershey’s, to revolutionize their Order-to-Cash, Treasury, and Record-to-Report ecosystems. Our trajectory is unmatched: from becoming the first Unicorn of 2020 to being a mainstay on the Forbes Cloud 100, we tripled our valuation to $3B+ in just twelve months. We don’t just follow the market; we define it.

Job Summary:

The Digital Transformation Advisor (DTA) for the AP Automation business unit is a high-impact, CEO-2 level position reporting directly to the Global Head-AP Sales. This role is a cornerstone of our growth strategy, tasked with accelerating revenue through both elite-level new logo acquisition and the strategic expansion of our global enterprise footprint.

As a subject matter expert in AP, P2P, and S2P, you will serve as a bridge between technical innovation and executive vision. We are looking for high-velocity professionals who embody our core pillars-Hungry, Humble, and High IQ-and possess a relentless "boots-on-the-ground" mentality, traveling 50%+ to command the room with prospects, clients, and internal leadership.

Route A: Digital Transformation Advisor | Account Management (Expansion)

- Focus: Scaling the HighRadius ecosystem within our world-class existing client base.

- Mission: Strategically identify "white space," engineer high-value upsells, and embed our AP solutions into the heart of our customers' multi-year ERP transformation roadmaps.

- Key Skills: Navigating complex internal politics, long-term strategic account orchestration, and master-level relationship farming.

Route B: Digital Transformation Advisor | Enterprise (Net New)

- Focus: Hunting and securing brand-new enterprise logos for the AP Automation Business Unit.

- Mission:  Penetrate untapped markets, build executive trust from the ground up, and position HighRadius as the undisputed premier solution for the Office of the CFO.

- Key Skills: High-velocity prospecting, aggressive competitive positioning, and the tactical precision to close complex enterprise deals.

Core Responsibilities (Both Roles)

- Strategic Influence:  Extracting critical intelligence from champions to shift stakeholders from "education" to "active buy mode."

- In-Person Bias: Leading from the front with a 50%+ travel commitment to conduct on-site discovery and high-impact ROI assessments.

- Operational Rigor:  Managing a high-stakes portfolio of 20+ accounts with extreme organizational precision, ensuring every sales cycle moves with relentless velocity

- Domain Leadership: Acting as the definitive SME to provide the "Strategic Why" that resonates with the CFO’s office

Requirements:

- Mandatory Domain Expertise: Proven mastery in Accounts Payable (AP), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Source-to-Pay (S2P) (Sales, Pre-Sales, or Consulting).

- Cultural Fit: Must demonstrate Hungry (pace/drive), Humble (radical coachability), and High IQ (strategic problem-solving) traits.

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Principal - Payments
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

Are you a Payments industry expert who loves working with complex financial workflows and advising companies on payment gateway connections with processors and banks? HighRadius is looking for a Digital Transformation Principal to champion our Payments Automation solutions.

In this highly strategic, pre-sales role, you will bridge the gap between complex B2B payments technology and executive-level business value. You will partner with Fortune 1000 CFOs to diagnose their current payment friction points and design modern, automated digital transformation strategies.

Your Day-to-Day:

- Strategic Discovery: Conduct deep-dive operational assessments to uncover friction in a prospect’s current B2B payment ecosystem (e.g., high interchange fees, manual cash application, cross-border and multi-currency complexities) and map them to HighRadius solutions with their corresponding value propositions.

- Value Engineering: Build and present compelling business cases, ROI models, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analyses to justify technology investments to finance executives.

- Executive Demonstrations: Deliver powerful, tailored product demonstrations to the Finance departments of enterprise-level clients, up to the CFO.

- Collaborative Strategy: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to architect scalable digital payment transformation roadmaps.

- Product Management Collaboration: Collaborate with Product Management and Strategy teams to influence the product roadmap based on real-world prospect feedback and emerging trends in the Payments industry.

What You'll Need to be Successful:

- Payments Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of the B2B payments landscape, including merchant acquiring, credit card processing (interchange optimization, Level 2/3/CEDP data), direct debit (ACH, SEPA, Bacs, BECS, etc.), alternative payment methods, digital wallets, real-time payments (RTP), and global payment gateways.

- Pre-Sales / Consulting Experience: Proven track record in a Sales Engineering, Solutions Consulting, or tech-focused Management Consulting role, ideally selling into the Office of the CFO

- Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, with a proven ability to build trust and sustain strategic relationships with C-suite executives.

- Analytical Mindset: Ability to translate complex technical workflows and solutions into quantifiable business value (ROI) and easily understandable customer-facing presentations.

- Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical/financial field.

- Travel: Willingness to travel domestically up to 40% to meet with enterprise prospects.

Perks & Benefits:

- Performance-based bonus or commission (for eligible roles)

- Competitive benefits, 401 (k) matching plan, and wellness resources

- Opportunity to earn stock options for top-performers

- Paid parental leave

- Paid company & flex holidays

- ZINGy environment: quarterly events, team outings, and MORE!

#LI-ONSITE

jobs.description:
Summary :

As a Manager, Strategic Alliances, you’ll be responsible for managing and engaging a portfolio of partners and advisors. A key component of this role will involve creating connections for executive decision makers within the partner's end-customer accounts.

This role will be based out of our HQ in Houston (zipcode: 77042), covering an assigned portfolio of HighRadius partners. Regular domestic travel (~25%) to meet with partners is expected.

Your Day to Day:

Maintain knowledge of the organizational structure and go-to-market strategy for finance transformation advisory work being sold by the partner organization and the key priority accounts that the partner organization is planning on selling to in each region/area/geography

- Proactively identify and establish connections with executive decision makers in end-customer accounts within your partner portfolio.

- Training and educating the appropriate stakeholders at the partner organization on HighRadius solutions and developing joint go-to-market strategies and materials

- Help develop the Data-Driven Assessment Tool Kit, and help our partners use the tool kit to perform quick assessments

What you need to be successful:

- Thrive in a multi-tasking environment and can adjust priorities on-the-fly while still having the ability to focus on details

- Experience in project management and developing/executing of successful plans

Perks & Benefits:

- Performance-based bonus or commission (for eligible roles)

- Competitive benefits, 401k matching plan and wellness resources

jobs.title: Procurement Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

HighRadius provides a single Agentic AI platform for the Office of the CFO. It integrates 180+ agents that orchestrate end-to-end processes across Order-to-Cash, Close & Reconciliation, Consolidation & Reporting, Accounts Payable, B2B Payments, and Treasury. HighRadius guarantees operational KPI improvements by mapping them to specific agents on the platform. With a 3-6 month go-live period, HighRadius drives value creation at 1300+ enterprises such as 3M, Unilever, Bristol-Myers Squibb Company, Red Bull, Lufthansa, and more. HighRadius has been consistently recognized as a market leader by Gartner, IDC, and Forrester.

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Procurement Manager to lead and optimize our software licensing, SaaS vendor portfolio, and overarching GTM/RevOps technology ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Procurement, Finance, IT, and Revenue Operations (Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success) to streamline the entire procurement lifecycle, drive strategic vendor relationships, and optimize multi-million dollar software spend.

You will serve as the strategic subject matter expert on SaaS procurement, ensuring our GTM technology stack actively supports business growth and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

- Strategic SaaS Procurement & Lifecycle Management : Lead the end-to-end strategic sourcing and procurement framework for all corporate software and SaaS applications. Oversee vendor discovery, evaluation, complex contract negotiations, onboarding, contract renewals, and onboarding workflows.

- GTM & RevOps Tech Stack Governance : Drive the procurement strategy for tools across the Revenue Operations ecosystem—including CRM (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), Sales Engagement (e.g., Salesloft, Outreach), Revenue Intelligence (e.g., Clari, Gong), Data Intelligence (e.g., ZoomInfo), and Lead Routing (e.g., LeanData).

- Strategic Spend & Portfolio Optimization : Continuously evaluate usage analytics, user adoption rates, and contract terms to eliminate redundancy, right-size subscriptions, prevent shelfware, and maximize return on investment (ROI).

- High-Stakes Contract Negotiation & Vendor Management : Lead complex enterprise negotiations to secure optimal pricing, favorable commercial terms, SLAs, volume discounts, and price locks. Develop strategic relationships with key strategic SaaS vendors.

- Security, Risk & Compliance Alignment : Partner closely with IT, InfoSec, and Legal teams to ensure all SaaS vendors adhere to strict security protocols (SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA), compliance requirements, and risk frameworks prior to contract execution.

- Process Improvement & Stakeholder Alignment : Collaborate with executive leadership across BizOps, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and IT to establish transparent procurement governance, streamline approval workflows, and implement SaaS management best practices.

Essential Skills & Qualifications

- Experience : 8 to 15 years of progressive experience in SaaS procurement, strategic sourcing, RevOps, BizOps, or vendor management within a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment.

- Domain Expertise : Deep hands-on knowledge of the GTM/RevOps technology ecosystem (CRM, Revenue Intelligence, Marketing Automation, Customer Success platforms) and SaaS licensing models.

- Financial & Analytical Acumen : Proven ability to build business cases, perform complex Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and ROI analyses, and leverage analytics tools (e.g., Excel, Power BI, Tableau).

- Negotiation & Legal Skills: Strong background in commercial contract terms, redlining SLAs, data privacy terms, and enterprise software pricing models.

- Leadership & Communication : Excellent stakeholder management skills with a track record of influencing executive decision-makers and cross-functional leaders.

- Education : Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s or MBA preferred).
